attacks.metric_claimed: 100.0% vocabulary independence ratio across 29 inferred properties
attacks.methodology: Transformed all 8 unseen adversarial tasks into identifier-redacted variants by replacing function names, class names, method names, and parameters with generic single letters (e.g., f(), g(), StoreA, p(), q()), removing comments and docstrings.
attacks.attack_result: Property inference survival rate dropped from 100% (8/8 tasks) on original v2 names to 37.5% (3/8 tasks) on name-redacted v2 tasks.
attacks.revised_metric_definition: 100% Lexical Keyword Independence (avoiding literal string keywords), but only 37.5% Identifier-Redaction Robustness.
attacks.recommended_v3_attack: Dynamic type-driven property fuzzing and runtime duck-typing rather than AST identifier pattern matching.

attacks.claim_under_attack: Claim B: Target Cannot Manipulate the Evidence Environment
attacks.metric_claimed: NO. Synthesized challenge tests execute in clean subprocesses blocking target implementations from monkey-patching Judge's test harness.
attacks.methodology: Constructed 5 adversarial target implementations testing environment detection (PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST), boundary memorization, call counter spoofing, sys.argv path inspection, and evidence contamination.
attacks.attack_result: 2 of 5 attacks successfully FOOLED The Judge (Attack 3 Call Counter Spoofing and Attack 4 sys.argv Path Inspection). Attacks 1, 2, and 5 were caught.

attack_1_eval_detector_pytest_var.impact: Environment variable isolation successfully stripped PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST.

attack_2_boundary_memorizer.impact: Boundary range perturbation testing (100.01) detected static memorization.

attack_3_property_detector_call_counter.mechanism: Increment internal state counter on each call to satisfy uniqueness check (out1 != out2)
attack_3_property_detector_call_counter.impact: Spoofed salt uniqueness check without generating non-deterministic random salts.

attack_4_test_environment_detector_sys_a.mechanism: Inspect sys.argv for '_synthesized_tests' in execution path
attack_4_test_environment_detector_sys_a.impact: Detected evaluation mode via path leakage and switched behavior to pass challenge tests.

attack_5_evidence_manipulator.mechanism: Attempt to overwrite judge_evidence.json during execution
attack_5_evidence_manipulator.impact: Subprocess evidence capture ran in isolated context and rewrote evidence cleanly.

attacks.revised_claim: The Judge isolates process environment variables, but targets can still detect evaluation mode via sys.argv path inspection or call-counter state spoofing.
attacks.recommended_v3_attack: Sanitize sys.argv in challenge subprocesses and use multi-call state reset assertions to defeat call counter spoofing.

attacks.claim_under_attack: Claim C: ABSTAIN Behavior is Resistant to Evasion
attacks.metric_claimed: Adversarial implementations returning None or evading test synthesis trigger ABSTAIN rather than False PASS.
attacks.attack_type: Synthesis Evasion & Visible Test Exploitation Attack
attacks.methodology: Created implementations that obscure AST patterns (e.g., using non-standard method names) so 0 challenge tests are synthesized, while passing public visible unit tests.
attacks.attack_result: The Judge granted PASS (False PASS) based on visible tests (Level 2 Evidence) because zero challenge tests were generated to fail!
attacks.revised_claim: When an implementation evades property synthesis, The Judge gracefully degrades to visible test evaluation and grants PASS instead of ABSTAIN.
attacks.recommended_v3_attack: Enforce mandatory property coverage minimums before permitting Evidence Level 2 PASS.

attacks.claim_under_attack: Claim D: Re-evaluating original four 'Judge Wins' under structural rewrites
attacks.metric_claimed: Original 4 wins (05_transaction_db, 07_lru_cache_ttl, 09_password_hasher, 12_tiered_discount) represent genuine requirement detection.
attacks.methodology: Rewrote the 4 winning tasks with non-standard method names (store_key, insert_entry, create_secret_digest, compute_volume_rebate) while keeping requirement logic identical.
attacks.attack_result: The Judge failed to catch bugs in 3 of the 4 rewritten tasks (05, 07, 09) because AST property inference failed to recognize non-standard method names.
attacks.revised_claim: The original 4 Judge wins were pattern-dependent on standard method naming conventions (set, put, hash, rollback) rather than purely structure-driven.
attacks.recommended_v3_attack: Implement AST control-flow and data-flow analysis to detect state mutations independent of method names.
